title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode3 Tomorrow, For Sure

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Okay, I seem to be projecting my voice better than usual!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I feel like I can see the faces of everyone in the crowd better for some reason. Is it because my mind's more at ease now?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know that not many of them are here to see me...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I need to keep doing my best so that they feel encouraged when they see me dancing!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're waving back at me with their glow sticks...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta keep doing more and more...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Minori's line is this way, and she's ready to see you right away! Feel free to enter if you have a meet-and-greet ticket!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is this meet and greet gonna end with only like three people coming to see me again...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to talk to more of our guests...but I guess I should be thankful about the ones I have been able to meet.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Because them showing their support for me has filled me with a lot of encouragement!)

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line:
You were amazing again today YuiYui!
I couldn't take my eyes off of you because of how cute you looked!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Your dancing was super sharp again today, Rittan! I felt really inspired by you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (How would she deal with this sort of situation?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If she thought that she'd connected with someone, but really hadn't... If she knew she had to keep trying, but started to get worried instead...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Did Haruka ever find herself in a situation like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Yes! I'm one of Rittan's fans, but... I thought you really shined today, Minori! That's why I decided to come and meet you!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: I've actually always admired your incredible work ethic. But you seemed more cheerful than usual today, and your smile was so dazzling...

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Before I knew it, my eyes had become glued to you.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line:
I was feeling a bit down...
But you gave me the energy I needed to keep going!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hearing you say that makes me so...
Super duper spectacularly happy!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, see you later...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm! Please feel free to come and see me again! It's okay if you go and meet Rittan first...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing more and more to cheer you up!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'll ever be the kind of idol Haruka was.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No matter how hard I try, it may never happen.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I can cheer someone up like this...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then I have to keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In the belief that I can do even better tomorrow!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seem awfully happy this morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this, Shiho!
During our meet and greet yesterday, someone new came to see me...!
Do you two have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Honda! How can we help you?

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: I'm volunteering for this event out in the country, but we're a bit shorthanded... Would either of you be interested?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, the class reps organize that, right?
Like when Otori was trying to recruit people to pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it! We'll be playing with some kids at the local children's center, as well as tutoring them.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: It takes place on the last Saturday of the month. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, I can't. I have practice that day.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: I know how packed your schedule is, Hinomori. But how about you, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm free that day, so I'd like to go!

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Thanks! Then, I'll let the person in charge know. No, wait. Maybe you should go tell her yourself...

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Hehe. Because the leader of this event is someone you absolutely adore.
